Chapter 4 of the Home and Community Care Policy Manual (PDF) was read on 20 September 2026, together with the [manual landing page](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/health/accessing-health-care/home-community-care/accountability/policy-and-standards/home-and-community-care-policy-manual). ## Annotation

Policy 4.C.1 describes CSIL as “a self-directed home support service” that health authorities “are responsible to fund” as “an alternative to receiving home support services.” It defines CSIL employer, client support group, CSIL representative, CSIL agreement, and CSIL funds. It states that clients receiving CSIL funding as of 31 March 2011 remain eligible after 1 April 2011 regardless of later eligibility criteria.

The inspected PDF does not give a 1993 or 1994 founding date and does not cite the 2008 Murtagh synthesis.
